$comment: VcpkgCaching_2 (RTM Build_01, Build_05): every library Iris-Slide builds against, first-party and third-party, prebuilt from vcpkg's binary cache; nothing is fetched at configure. The core is what every build needs, the JavaScript module's included: Iris-Headers and Iris-File-Extension. The baseline is vcpkg's release 2026.10.16 (scripts/bootstrap_vcpkg.cmake checks vcpkg out at it). Each direct third-party dependency's version is stated by an override, equal to Iris-Headers' cmake/dependencies.cmake where vcpkg has that version; Iris-Headers and Iris-File-Extension are pinned by commit in their overlay ports (ports/), and aom at 3.15.3 by vcpkg's own port as an overlay (D22), since no vcpkg release carries it yet. development/PIPELINE.md lists each pin, its source and every difference.
name: iris-slide

library.description: The Iris-Slide library, the decoder (CMakeLists.txt): the image codecs, Highway, and the Vulkan, VMA and GLM headers Iris-Headers' private headers include

encoder.description: IrisSlideEncoder and the Python encoder module (IRIS_BUILD_ENCODER=ON): libdicom, OpenJPEG for JPEG 2000 and HTJ2K source frames, and libaom and libyuv for AV1 tiles (D22)

python.description: The Python modules (IRIS_BUILD_PYTHON=ON): pybind11, its headers and CMake files only (ports/pybind11)

tests.description: The tests (TestHarness_1): Catch2, and dav1d to decode the encoder's AV1 tiles back (D22)
